answers.question: Burlöv (`740000937`): withheld: OSM joins no footway to the platforms and tags no entrance
answers.answer: Trafikverket confirms the layout: two island platforms (one serving tracks 61–62, one 63–64) between the four tracks, reached by stairs and a lift each from a pedestrian and cycle tunnel under the tracks; the tunnel opens to the street on the east (Burlöv Center) and west sides by stairs and accessible ramps. OSM has the tunnel, two lifts (-1;0) and stairs, but not the platform refs or entrance nodes, so the app needs the footways joined (tunnel → lift/stairs → each platform) and the two tunnel mouths as entrances. Station opened 9 December 2023.
